messages:
andrew: Heads-up — Orion (private VPC) deploy slated for TOMORROW 2026-04-05 11:00 PST. Expected ~45m window. I want a quick async sync here: who's on the execute path, who validates, and rollback owner?

sana: I can own smoke validation and logs/checks after the push. Will be on call 10:30–12:30 PST. Please @me for the smoke checklist.

pete: I'll be the primary deployer. Will run the Terraform apply + k8s rollout. Planning to cut traffic, apply, then bring back.

leila: I'll be on rollback standby and can kick off the DB failover if needed. Quick Q: are there any schema changes?

andrew: No DB schema changes for this deploy — just model weights + runtime config. No migration required. Leila, rollback will be reverting to previous model image + config and redeploying the old ASG set.

pete: Plan:
```
# simplified steps
1. cordon new nodes
2. terraform apply -var-file=orion-prod.tfvars
3. kubectl rollout restart deploy/orion-inference
4. run smoke script
```
I'll post the actual commands in the runbook channel 15m before start.

andrew: Smoke checks (Sana to run) — quick list:
- curl -sS https://orion-api.prod.internal/health | jq .status : should be "ok"
- Sample generation latency under 500ms for 1-token prompt
- Check Redis/KV cache hitrate didn't drop below 95%
- Verify logs for new WARN/ERROR spikes over baseline

sana: Got it. I'll use this snippet for latency test:
```
for i in {1..20}; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}\n" https://orion-api.prod.internal/generate?prompt=hi; done
```
Will post median latency in the thread.

andrew: Network/team notes: ingress ACLs already staged by infra. @deploy-bot can you confirm firewall rules applied to the customer VPC (rule set orion-allowed-ips) are in place?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Firewall check for orion-allowed-ips: PASS — 3 rules present, last modified 2026-04-03T19:12:10Z.

pete: FYI I'll do a canary 10% for 10 minutes then bump to 100% if no errors. If any 5xx or latency > 2s for >1% of requests, immediate rollback.

leila: Rollback steps documented in runbook under /runbooks/orion/rollback.md. I also have the previous container SHA: sha256:abcd1234 and kube manifest tagged as v1.8.2.

andrew: Permissions/approvals: we need a quick prod-allow from security for the VPC peering change (small ip range). @sana has the security approver role.

sana: I approve the peering change assuming the ingress IP list matches the approved CIDR. I saw a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ORION-78 — is that the one?

andrew: Yes ORION-78 is the peering + ACL ticket. Pete — can you paste the terraform plan output link after `terraform plan`? We need a reviewer to glance over before apply.

pete: Will do. Reviewer ping: @andrew @leila please glance at the plan. Quick things to check: no unexpected create/destroy of DB subnets or route tables.

leila: Glanced — looks good for infra. Minor nit: a new security group rule references a broad 0.0.0.0/0 for health checks; please narrow to the monitoring subnet.

pete: Good catch, I'll tighten that and re-run plan.

andrew: Code review: small runtime config change in infra repo — I already merged the PR after a quick review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432 — includes the peering block.

sana: Anything for the console team? We should add a short banner for the customer indicating maintenance window. If someone from marketing needs copy let me know.

andrew: Not required but appreciated. Pete, please add a host-level tag so we can filter metrics for the window.

pete: Will tag hosts with `maintenance:orion-20260405` during the window.

andrew: Last checks: backup in place?

leila: Snapshots ran at 09:00 PST today. Verified sizes and integrity.

pete: Ok team — executing manual dry-run in staging at 18:00 PT today. I'll report results here. If staging goes green, we proceed tomorrow at 11:00 PST.

sana: :thumbsup: staging smoke passed locally, median latency 320ms and no error spikes. I'll join 10m before and run the smoke suite live.

andrew: Thanks — tagging final owners: pete (deployer), sana (smoke/validation), leila (rollback), andrew (coordinator). If anything changes overnight, update thread.

pete: Copy. Posting terraform plan link and updated command list 30m before start.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: Orion VPC deploy in 23h 30m at 2026-04-05T18:00:00Z (11:00 PST).
